item.dc:creator: AKTUAL MEDIA

item.title: Review: Apple is adding face unlock to the iPhone Duo — without new hardware
item.description: Apple is working on a face unlock feature for the iPhone Duo that uses the front-facing camera for authentication, and it's already testing it with the new iOS 27.3 beta released today, as reported by MacRumors.
